claim.en: Per The Slovak Spectator, Minister Taraba replaced expert Eva Kolesárová as head of the Bodrog River Basin Administration with SNS district chair Vaľo; Taraba and Danko called him equally qualified, but Denník N reported he never did water management.
claim.sk: Podľa The Slovak Spectator minister Taraba nahradil na čele Správy povodia Bodrogu odborníčku Evu Kolesárovú okresným predsedom SNS Vaľom; Taraba a Danko ho označili za rovnako kvalifikovaného, podľa Denníka N sa však vodnému hospodárstvu nevenoval.

findings.identity: Jaroslav Vaľo, SNS district chairman from Michalovce district (per Pravda), SNS candidate from Malčice, occupation director.
findings.quote: Minister Taraba replaced her with Jaroslav Vaľo, the district chair of the SNS party. According to Taraba and SNS chair Andrej Danko, Vaľo is equally qualified and has been working in the company for 17 years. … However, according to information from the Denník N daily, Vaľo did not engage in water management. Instead, he was responsible for overseeing a single workshop in the company, where he was in charge of maintaining lorries, construction equipment, and lawnmowers.
findings.title: Minister sacks top environment experts, replaces them with party members

claim.en: In December 2023 opposition MP Kiča criticized Vaľo's installation as head of the Bodrog River Basin Administration, saying he had no link to water management and that on social media he sent President Čaputová, labelled a monster, to hell.
claim.sk: V decembri 2023 opozičný poslanec Kiča kritizoval dosadenie Vaľa na čelo Správy povodia Bodrogu s tým, že nemá vzťah k vodnému hospodárstvu a na sociálnych sieťach posiela prezidentku Čaputovú, označenú ako monštrum, do psej matere.

findings.identity: Jaroslav Vaľo, SNS district chairman from Michalovce; the candidate is an SNS nominee from Malčice (Michalovce district), occupation director.
findings.quote: Na jej stoličku zasadol ďalší okresný predseda SNS, tentokrát z Michaloviec Jaroslav Vaľo. … O Vaľovom vzťahu k vodnému hospodárstvu nenájdete nič. K jeho kvalifikácii sa dá dohľadať akurát tak varenie gulášu na straníckych akciách a na sociálnych sieťach posiela prezidentku Zuzanu Čaputovú, označenú ako monštrum, do psej matere," uviedol Kiča.
findings.title: Taraba obsadzuje pozície v rezorte straníckymi nominantmi. Kiča hovorí o groteske
